Create two synthetic accounts and select two distinct profiles in a fresh scratch org. Substitute their IDs for the placeholders in the provider metadata, then deploy three synthetic Salesforce-managed providers without initiating authentication. Update the FlowDefaultAccountId of two providers through the data API. At API 63.0 through 67.0, describe both fields and, wherever present, require one saved null and two distinct populated IDs for each field before collecting five ORDER BY variants. The API 62.0 describe absence is in nulls_order_remaining_lookup/org.tsv.
